text:
Ash Deol: hey team :wave: i'm ash (they/them), joining the serving runtime squad as a SWE. based in singapore (SGT), remote-first but i'll be in SF for onboarding in April. big fan of spicy laksa, synthwave, and tiny plush corgis. quick q: who handles office keys + badge activation for folks coming in from overseas? also curious about coffee vs instant situation ☕️

Nora Li: welcome Ash!! i'm Nora from People Ops. i'll set up badge access and add you to the visitor list for your SF dates. sending a quick onboarding checklist DM.

Ben Park: welcome!! for office keys ping @ops-desks but we usually have temporary badges at reception for the first week. coffee-wise: we have espresso machine + a rotating selection of pods. instant only if desperate :joy:

Marcus Vega: hey ash  i have a spare USB-C dock you can use while you wait for your kit. it's labeled "bench-reserve" in storage.

People Ops Bot: Badge request submitted for Ash Deol. Ticket #H-5588. ETA: 1 business day.

Devex-Bot: Added Ash to #serving-runtime, #synthwave-and-sounds, and #lunch-pals. Welcome! :tada:

Juniper Saito: spicy laksa club unite. i bring literal laksa to potlucks sometimes if you promise to share :bowl_with_spoon:

Ash Deol: count me in for the potluck :raised_hands: also tagging remote SF friends  would love any tips for good bike routes around soma.

Lina Gomez: welcome! re: plants  if you want a low-maint desk plant i can bring one from the office greenery cupboard. label it with your initials if ya want it to survive the fridge raids.

Ben Park: also heads up we have a running tiny poll in #random about the mysterious "missing sandwich" phenomenon. rules: label, or it becomes folklore.

Ash Deol: lol noted. thanks all, excited to be here :sparkles: will DM for logistics and see some of you in April!
